# automox_prepatch_report (Data Source)

Automox's prepatch report: what would be applied on the next patch run, by device and severity.

This is the largest read the provider offers — roughly a megabyte for a fleet of 1,500 — and all of it lands in Terraform state. Use it for reporting, not as an input to resources.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `critical` (Number)
- `devices` (Attributes List) Devices with outstanding patches. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `high` (Number)
- `low` (Number)
- `medium` (Number)
- `needs_attention` (Number) Devices in this report that also need attention.
- `no_known_cves` (Number) Devices whose outstanding patches carry no known CVEs.
- `none` (Number)
- `total` (Number) Devices covered by the report.
- `unknown` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `compliant` (Boolean)
- `connected` (Boolean)
- `create_time` (String)
- `group` (String) The device's server group, by name rather than ID here.
- `id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `needs_reboot` (Boolean)
- `os_family` (String)
- `patches` (Attributes List) Patches outstanding on this device. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices--patches))

<a id="nestedatt--devices--patches"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices.patches`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String)
- `cves` (List of String) CVE identifiers this patch addresses. Automox returns these under a singular `cve` key.
- `id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `needs_approval` (Boolean) Whether the patch is held pending approval.
- `patch_time` (String)
- `severity` (String)
